About me

I am a PhD student in Astrophysics at Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile and a research assistant at the Centro de Astro-Ingeniería UC. My work sits at the intersection of theoretical cosmology, numerical computation, and data analysis. I am particularly interested in late-time dark-sector models, the nonlinear growth of structure, halo statistics, modified gravity, and optimal-transport methods in cosmology.
